verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS platform holding sensitive cap table and fund data, so data region or residency selection is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options, or choosing where data lives. The docs cover API access, OAuth, the MCP plugins and the data warehouse, none of which address data location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
